core_detail.interpretation: All components belong to this case only. Process-local inclusive/self statistics, full contexts/source maps, CUDA events and point observations retained separately; no parent/child inclusive sum, no independent diagnostic splice, no total-phase/resource/mean estimate. Instrumentation overhead remains unquantified.

delivery_detail.timing_semantics: Same instrumented export. Never add parent/child inclusive_s or add worker/join to parent wall. Contexts are same-thread nested paths; self_s excludes measured direct children only. Serial encoding_join_s is encode call wall; with parallel encoding it would be FIFO wait only. ZIP member_wall_s includes per-member metadata wrapper overhead; timer is its inner measured write span. No nested totals, multi-case means, or resource peaks are computed here.
